prompt:
You are a hardware-debug illustrator. Draw ONE technical signal-flow diagram (dark background, light labels) explaining a RISC-V RTL failure.
Case: picosoc-uart-div
Failing-trace sha256 (first 16 hex): 8183ccc1937eaeb4
Verbatim diagnosis from the debug agent:
Loopback sent 0xa5 but recv_buf_data latched 0xe0, causing TRAP uart data mismatch. RX start half-bit in state 1 waits 2*recv_divcnt > cfg_divider (half bit), but states default/10 advance when recv_divcnt > (cfg_divider >> 4), i.e. 1/16 of a bit period, so recv_pattern shifts ser_rx 16x too fast and samples wrong bit positions.
Diagram MUST show: the failing signal path named in the diagnosis, the wrong value vs the expected value, and the single RTL line to fix. Annotate the trace hash 8183ccc1937eaeb4 in a corner as provenance. No decorative elements, no invented signals.
